title: Trail and Provision
author: Xanthe Sandoval
blurb: Yara Whitlock, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
